name: Natatsuka Touko
source:
Shizuka's caretaker and bodyguard.
A second-year student at Masumi Private Girls' Academy.

She has no family and lives in a detached house of the Otobe family.
She used to live with her grandfather, but her grandfather was a wanderer, and Shizuka's grandfather was the boss of the gang, and was grateful to him for providing lodging and food.

She was told to return the favor to the Otobe gang when the time came, and when her grandfather passed away, she was taken in by Shizuka's family.
That's why she has grown up with Shizuka since she was a child.

In order to fulfill her role as Shizuka's bodyguard, she has learned various martial arts.
In a one-on-one fight, she is strong enough to fight on equal terms with an adult man.
She also knows how to handle various weapons.

She tries to treat Shizuka as her master and caretaker, but Shizuka treats her as a childhood friend and friend, so she is happy but worried about the distance between them.

She belongs to the "Magic Club" with Shizuka, but she is worse at magic than Shizuka.
She is pretty clumsy at everything except handling weapons.
